monitor_disabled: {char}: monitor '{mon}' is disabled in this profile – filled elsewhere
cell_blocked: {char}: slot {slot} is marked as kept free
too_small: {char}: slot {slot} ({w}x{h}) is smaller than the EVE minimum {mw}x{mh}
span_outside: Span {c}x{r} from slot {slot} extends beyond the grid
no_monitors: No monitors defined in the configuration
yaml_missing: PyYAML missing (pip install pyyaml) – or use config.json
no_config: No configuration found (searched: {paths}). Create one with `fcwm init`.
init_done:
Configuration created: {path}
Next: run `fcwm web` or enable the service: systemctl --user enable --now fcwm
not_running: fcwm is not running (neither service nor `fcwm web`). Start it with: systemctl --user start fcwm
cleanup_service: The fcwm service is still running – first: systemctl --user disable --now fcwm
cleanup_done: Cleaned up: {scripts} KWin scripts unloaded, {shortcuts} shortcuts and {rules} window rules removed, color schemes deleted. Your configuration is kept.
kwin_no_reply: No reply from the KWin script (journalctl). Is KWin logging to the journal?
wayland_no_kwin: Wayland without a reachable KWin – X11 tools cannot move windows here
app_missing: The app window needs PyQt6-WebEngine (Arch: python-pyqt6-webengine, Debian/Ubuntu: python3-pyqt6.qtwebengine, pip: PyQt6-WebEngine) – opening the browser instead.
